experiment.title: Is the already-known-share coefficient alpha?
experiment.parent_result: Notebook 85 test T3: within-session rank coefficient on already-known share = -0.00882, 95% HAC(5) CI [-0.01387, -0.00376], BH q=0.0019, on 2,263 FNSPID development sessions
experiment.question: Translate that coefficient into economic magnitude, test whether it is an artifact of the firm's own price path or of repeat polarity, and price it as a portfolio net of costs.
experiment.evidence_role: retrospective development translation plus one exploratory application to the already-opened evaluation block

evaluation_block_disclosure.opened_by: Notebook 75 executed the preregistered beyond-the-mean evaluation family once after Gate F1
evaluation_block_disclosure.precedent: Notebook 81 applies a development-selected rule unchanged to the same already-opened 2020-2023 block and is recorded as an exploratory background null
evaluation_block_disclosure.role_here: The 2020-2023 block is NOT a pristine holdout and is not treated as confirmation. The rule below is frozen on development in this file before any evaluation return is computed, then applied unchanged and once.
evaluation_block_disclosure.selection_disclosure: T3 is the surviving member of a three-test development family. Its evaluation numbers are therefore a retrospective check on a development-selected signal, not independent validation.

fnspid_price_archive.role: Notebook 79 price-path controls, rebuilt with the identical construction and extended to 2023-12-31 for the evaluation replay

signal_definition.already_known: unchanged Notebook 85 screen at the operative Jaccard threshold 0.50
signal_definition.known_share: count of already-known stories divided by total stories on the firm-day
signal_definition.no_retuning: The threshold, window, outcome, horizon and cost are inherited unchanged from Notebooks 85 and 03. No parameter is searched in this notebook.

magnitude_translation.quantile_sort: within-session quintiles of known_share on firm-days with at least ten complete names; report mean ar_open_h1 in basis points per quintile and the Q5 minus Q1 spread
magnitude_translation.inference: 20-session circular block bootstrap of the daily spread, 9,999 replications, seed 20260814

mechanism_checks.name: repeat polarity decomposition
mechanism_checks.model: rank(ar_open_h1) ~ rank(mean_continuous) + rank(negative_share) + rank(known_share_negative) + rank(known_share_nonnegative) + rank(log1p(n))
mechanism_checks.question: Does the effect come from restated bad news specifically, or from repetition of any polarity?

mechanism_checks.name: price-path controls
mechanism_checks.model: the Notebook 85 T3 model plus within-session ranks of lagged_return_1, lagged_return_5 and sigma20, built exactly as in Notebook 79
mechanism_checks.question: Is a high repeat share simply following a price move?

mechanism_checks.name: exact-repeat-only definition
mechanism_checks.model: the Notebook 85 T3 model with known_share computed from exact normalized-hash repeats only
mechanism_checks.question: Does the sign survive the strictest, least noisy definition?

mechanism_checks.name: story-count and calendar-year stability
mechanism_checks.model: the Notebook 85 T3 model estimated within story-count bins and within calendar years
mechanism_checks.question: Is the coefficient carried by one stratum or one period?

books.name: raw known_share sort
books.note: short high-repeat firm-days, long low-repeat; this is the simple tradable version and is NOT the quantity the conditional coefficient describes

books.name: conditional residual sort
books.signal: within-session rank residual of known_share after ranks of mean_continuous, negative_share and log1p(n)
books.note: this is the tradable form of the T3 coefficient itself

economic_translation.construction: unchanged lib.evaluate cross-sectional dollar-neutral cs_rank book, one-session ar_open_h1 hold, min_names 2
economic_translation.cost: 10 bps per side charged as 2 x half-L1 turnover x rate, matching every other arm in this programme
reported: mean gross and net basis points per session
mean net exposure, asserted near zero
5-session block-bootstrap interval on mean net return

alpha_gate.description: The single declared standard for calling this alpha. All five must hold on the development block, and the evaluation replay must not reverse the sign.
conditions: positive net Sharpe at the charged 10 bps per side
break-even cost at least equal to the 10 bps per side charged
block-bootstrap lower bound on mean net return above zero
positive net Sharpe in both temporal halves of the development block
the coefficient survives the M2 price-path controls with the same sign
alpha_gate.failure_action: Record the null. Do not search thresholds, horizons, weighting schemes or subsets to rescue it.

stopping_rule: One execution. The evaluation block is computed once, after the development gate result is written, and is not used to reselect anything.
licence_boundary: No headline text is loaded. All artifacts are written to the gitignored final_experiments/outputs/86_fnspid_already_known_share_economic_value/ directory.
